fields.statement: Built ./cmd/rhiza (HEAD 289c5fa77) to a scratch path; ran it in a scratch Rhiza root with a fake claude (real hook path) and fake rex, runs not started --autonomous. Workflow conduct (agent step with [[check]] qa): the conductor session launched with RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1 and its PreToolUse AskUserQuestion got the deny reply with the arbiter reason; a builder child from rhiza run spawn in that step also had RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1 and was denied. Failure case: workflow plain (agent step, no checks): the session and its spawned child had no RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS, the hook printed nothing, and the step blocked on the owner. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/api -run 'TestRunSpawn|TestSessionHook|TestStepRunnerConductorAutonomous' ok.

Built ./cmd/rhiza (HEAD 289c5fa77) to a scratch path; ran it in a scratch Rhiza root with a fake claude (real hook path) and fake rex, runs not started --autonomous. Conduct step's own question: asked entry, question node, arbiter pass, answer typed into its tab, run succeeded, no advisor entry and no state=blocked notice; same through workflow outer whose workflow step includes conduct (step conduct/conduct). Failure case: arbiter wrote no Decision, so the run failed with the step's error naming the question ('arbiter failed on question question-...-1 (...)'). Regression: workflow plain blocked on the owner with a state=blocked notice and an advisor entry, no asked entry. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/run -run 'TestConductorQuestion|TestNormalRunQuestionNotArbitrated|TestAutonomousQuestionGoesToArbiter|TestAutonomousArbiterFailFailsRun' ok.

Built ./cmd/rhiza (HEAD 289c5fa77) to a scratch path; ran it in a scratch Rhiza root with a fake claude (real hook path) and fake rex, runs not started --autonomous. Conduct step whose conductor spawned a builder child that asked: asked entry keyed on the child session, arbiter pass, the answer sent to the child (messages/<child>/0001.md), answered and unblocked entries, then spawn-ended, and the step passed on the conductor's own outcome; no advisor and no blocked notice. A child asking two questions in turn got both arbitrated and answered (2 asked/arbiter/answered entries). Failure case: arbiter wrote no Decision on the child's question, so the step ended in error naming the question and the run failed. A child spawned in a plain step was not watched: no asked or arbiter entries. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/run -run TestSpawnedChildQuestion ok.
